ads.name: P12 reel A1: factory ka address
ads.headline: Your factory's address in Rohtak
ads.text: Apni factory ke liye address chahiye? Forteasia Industrial Township, Kalanaur, Rohtak: 138 acre industrial park, plots 400 se 4,000 gaj, 24 m wide roads, electrical substation, STP, CCTV, fire safety. NH-152D se 10 min. Haryana MSME Policy 2026 subsidies (subject to eligibility). HRERA-PKL-ROH-653-2025, HRERA-PKL-ROH-795-2025, www.haryanarera.gov.in. Tap the WhatsApp button to know more.
ads.prefill: Hi, I saw the FIT ad. Please share the industrial plot details.
